description: The full M5 progression on one save: a first run owns the four starters, the twelve purchasables are bought in schedule order through the production ledger and shop, a second purchase of an owned tool charges nothing, mid-progression reloads restore the same save at schema 6, all sixteen interactions end up owned and selectable, switching grab variants mid-hold drops rather than flings, an expensive tool needs money rather than cheaper neighbours, an armed-but-unconfirmed reset changes nothing, and a confirmed reset returns the save to a first run without ever writing the settings payload.
